System_Information.Title: Perez 2019 case study - base case with LPP
System_Information.Description: Case-study base deck: configuration D1 of Estupinan Perez et al. (2019), CO2/N2 VSA on 13X, run by devices on a 6-step n-bed schedule (fraction mode, n_beds = 3): feed (1/n), blowdown and evacuation on one vacuum pump (1/n), LPP through a valve from the partner bed in its feed 1, idle. Feed by a blower, vent valve to the atmosphere, Ergun momentum. Settings the case study varies: variable[n_beds], variable[t_feed], variable[feed_velocity], variable[blowdown_share], variable[vacuum_pump_power], variable[vp_eta_max], variable[vp_alpha], variable[blower_efficiency], variable[cv_vent], variable[p_atm], variable[p_evac_floor], variable[purity_target], variable[recovery_target], variable[cv_lpp], variable[feed1_share]. p_evac_floor, purity_target and recovery_target are constraint values, not used by the run.
System_Information.Author: Skarstrom examples

Variables.Name: n_beds
Variables.Description: beds in the schedule: feed 1/n, vacuum pump 1/n of the cycle

Variables.Name: blowdown_share
Variables.Description: share of the vacuum pump's 1/n of the cycle spent in blowdown

Variables.Name: feed_velocity
Variables.Description: superficial feed velocity delivered by the blower

Variables.Name: p_atm
Variables.Description: atmosphere: vent, blower suction and vacuum-pump discharge pressure

Variables.Name: vacuum_pump_power
Variables.Description: vacuum pump shaft power at full vacuum [W] (W = W_max (1 - P / p_atm))

Variables.Name: vp_eta_max
Variables.Description: vacuum pump efficiency curve: maximum efficiency

Variables.Name: t_feed
Variables.Description: feed time, feed 1 + feed 2 (1/n of the cycle)

Variables.Name: feed1_share
Variables.Description: share of the feed 1/n in feed 1 (the step that supplies the LPP)
